title: Concept: Secret in a framework or file context (ini) — review required
description: In ini, passwords*=s*[^"'s]S* places a secret where the framework or file format expects it. Context does not protect the value: it still lands in history, images, and dumps. The remedy is external storage via a secret include outside version control.
applicability: ini framework settings, connection strings, and config files; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Credential exposure through checkouts and artifacts; HIGH severity when the value is live.
